design_criteria.water_quality_volume_method: Permanent BMPs must remove at least 80% of the increase in TSS load from development; capture volume is sized from annual pollutant load (L = A × P × Rv × C × 0.226) and BMP-specific TSS removal efficiency.

extraction_quality.review_notes: TCEQ RG-348 technical guidance implementing Edwards Aquifer rules (30 TAC Chapter 213) for eight central Texas counties. Primary permanent BMP list from Table 3-1; temporary construction BMPs from Chapter 1 included where commonly cited.

design_parameters.enrich_notes: WQV rainfall depth is site-specific via Table 3-5 fraction F (examples: 1.46 in, 2.60 in); storage sized with 20% sediment allowance. Infiltration basins/trenches excluded in most of the area; sites with infiltration <0.5 in/hr precluded. Wet vault sizing uses 1.1 in/hr rainfall intensity (not WQV depth).
